SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4753
Date 11/4/33

SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, APRIL 7, 1933

Text Of Decree Abolishing
Tael Unit From Currency

Central Political Council Passes Resolution Adopt-
ing Proposal Which Eliminates Tael Unit
As Legal Tender In China

NANKING, April 6.—Complete abolition of the tael, with effect as from April 6, was decided upon at the 351st meeting of the Central Political Council yesterday.
The resolution, which was moved by Mr. T. V. Soong, Minister of Finance, reads as follows:—
Mr. Soong's Resolution
"The rate of exchange between the tael and the yuan (dollar) having already been promulgated, be it resolved that, beginning from April 6 of the current year, all payments and receipts of private or public funds, as well as all transactions of any nature whatsoever must be made in terms of the silver dollar, failing which they shall be considered null and void in law; and that a duty of 2.25 per cent. be imposed on silver and other kindred metals which may be used for the coinage of the silver dollar, with the exception of the mint bars produced by the Central Mint."
The following is a free translation of the proposal submitted by the Minister of Finance:—
Translation Of Proposal
"The rate of exchange between the tael and the yuan having been duly approved by the Council, has subsequently been promulgated and put into effect at Shanghai since March 10.
"It is hereby proposed that beginning from April 6 of the current year, all payments and receipts of public and private funds, as well as all transactions of any nature whatsoever, must be made in terms of the dollar, instead of the tael; that in all transactions entered into prior to that date in terms of the tael, payments and receipts shall also be made in terms of the dollar, according to the rate of exchange of 0.715 Shanghai-tael to one dollar; that in the event of disputes arising in the cases just referred to, the Courts of Justice shall dismiss all claims insisting upon payments in taels; that any contracts, negotiable instruments, transactions, and payments or receipts of public or private funds, which are made or entered into after the said date in terms of the tael shall be considered null and void under Law; and that the Ministry of Audit shall refuse to sanction any accounts submitted by any Government organ, after the said date, which contain entries of payments or receipts in taels. It is respectfully proposed that the above measures be adopted and referred to the Executive, the Judicial and the Control Yuans and through them, to their various subordinate organs, for general enforcement and observance."
Proposal For Silver Duty
In a separate proposal for the institution of an export duty on silver, Minister Soong stated: "Having already been proposed that beginning from April 6 of the current year all payments and receipts of public or private funds as well as all transactions of any nature whatsoever be made in terms of the dollar instead of the tael, it is necessary to impose a duty on silver and other kindred metals which may be used for the coinage of the silver dollar, with the exception of the mint bars produced by the Central Mint. It is therefore proposed that a duty of 2.25 per cent. be imposed on silver and other kindred metals which may be used for the coinage of the silver dollar, with the exception of the mint bars produced by the Central Mint."

上海公共租界工部局警务处
及特别分部登记处
编号 D 4753
日期 1933年4月11日

《字林西报》，1933年4月7日，星期五

废除货币中银两单位的法令全文

中央政治委员会通过决议，采纳关于取消银两作为中国法定货币的提案

南京，4月6日电。——在昨日举行的中央政治委员会第351次会议上，决定自4月6日起彻底废除银两。
该决议由财政部长宋子文先生提出，内容如下：
宋子文先生的决议
“鉴于银两与元（圆）之间的兑换率已经公布，兹决议：自本年4月6日起，所有公私款项的收付以及任何性质的交易，均须以银圆为单位进行，否则在法律上视为无效；并对可用于铸造银圆的白银及其他同类金属征收2.25%的税捐，但中央造币厂生产的铸币用银条除外。”
以下为财政部部长所提交提案的自由译文：
提案译文
“银两与元的兑换率经委员会正式批准后，已于3月10日在上海公布并实施。
“兹提议：自本年4月6日起，所有公私款项的收付以及任何性质的交易，均须以元而非银两为单位进行；对于在该日期之前以银两订立的各项交易，其收付款项亦应按上海银两0.715两兑一元的汇率折算为元进行支付和收取；若就上述情况发生争议，司法机关应驳回所有坚持要求以银两支付的诉求；凡在该日期之后以银两订立或进行的任何合同、票据、交易及公私款项的收付，在法律上均视为无效；审计部应拒绝核准任何政府机关在该日期之后提交的、包含以银两计值的收支账目的报表。谨请采纳上述措施，并转交行政院、司法院及监察院，再由各院转饬其下属各机关，以便普遍执行和遵守。”
关于白银税捐的提案
在另一份关于设立白银出口税的提案中，宋部长陈述道：“鉴于已提议自本年4月6日起，所有公私款项的收付及任何性质的交易均须以元而非银两为单位进行，因此有必要对可用于铸造银圆的白银及其他同类金属征收税捐，但中央造币厂生产的铸币用银条除外。故提议对可用于铸造银圆的白银及其他同类金属征收2.25%的税捐，但中央造币厂生产的铸币用银条除外。”

（批注：1933年4月8日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4753
Date 11 / 4 / 23

April 11, 19..    2.    Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE ABOLITION OF THE TAEL.

The Chinese Ratepayers Association in
the International Settlement yesterday despatched the
following letter to the Secretary-General of the
Shanghai Municipal Council:-
"The Municipality has received an order
from the Ministry of Finance to enforce the abolition
of the Tael and to adopt the dollar as a monetary unit.
Therefore, all taxes collected by the Council and the
charges for electricity, water, telephone, gas, etc.
should be in dollars as from April 6 at the exchange
rate of $.715 to a dollar.
"The Council is requested to instruct
the various public business organisations and the
Council to act accordingly".

Eastern Times and other local newspapers:

MINT DIRECTOR TO RESIGN.

Kwoh Zung-en, Director of the Central
Mint, a few days ago, submitted a petition to the
Ministry of Finance tendering his resignation from
his post.
It is said that Loo Hsuch-pon, Chief of the
Board of Directors of the Bank of Communications, will
be appointed to replace him.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

OPPRESSION OF CHINESE IN MEXICO: COMMISSION COMING
HERE ON "EMPRESS OF JAPAN".

Owing to the intolerable oppression at
the hands of the Mexican Government, the overseas Chinese
in Mexico organised an Appeal Commission of about 70
members to make an appeal to the Chinese Government
to protect the lives and property of the overseas
Chinese and to stop the boycott against Chinese.
The Commission are travelling on the
S.S. "Empress of Japan" and are due to arrive in Shanghai
on the afternoon of April 11.
The Overseas Chinese General Club will
convene a large meeting to welcome the Commission.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央及特别分部登记处
编号 D 4753
日期 1923年4月11日 [注：原文年份印刷为23，结合上下文应为1933]

19..年4月11日    2.    下午译文。

杂项。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

废除银两。

公共租界华人纳税会于昨日致函上海工部局总办，信件内容如下：
“本局已接到财政部命令，要求执行废除银两并采用元作为货币单位。因此，自4月6日起，工部局征收的所有税款以及电费、水费、电话费、煤气费等收费，均应按0.715两兑一元的汇率以元计算。
“请工部局指示各公用事业机构及工部局各部门照此办理”。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

造币厂总监辞职。

中央造币厂总监郭宗恩（Kwoh Zung-en，音译）于数日前向财政部递交辞呈，申请辞去职务。
据悉，交通银行董事会主席陆叙彭（Loo Hsuch-pon，音译）将被任命接替其职。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

墨西哥迫害华人：代表团乘“日本皇后号”来沪。

由于墨西哥政府的迫害令人难以忍受，在墨华侨组织了约70人的请愿代表团，向中国政府呼吁保护华侨生命财产，并制止抵制华人的行为。
该代表团乘坐“日本皇后号”轮船前来，预计于4月11日下午抵达上海。
华侨总会将召开大型会议欢迎该代表团。
